text: Personal fields were erased on a device of this account. The erasure becomes final after 7 days; until then an admin of this account can take it back.
when: No call returns it: the space status gives it with each provisional erasure (provisional_erasures, provisionalErasures), on every device of the account, while an erasure in a space with one account waits out its 7 days. pm's text, NOC-234.
